class.name: OcgGceMakemirror2d
class.brief_description: This class implements elementary construction algorithms for a symmetrical transformation in 2D space about a point or axis. The result is a gp_Trsf2d transformation. A MakeMirror2d object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and consulting the result.
